messages.text:
"Create an original 2D anime fantasy hero collection RPG inspired by the gameplay systems of Seven Hearts.

Game title: ARCANIS – THE SEVEN SOULS.

IMPORTANT GAMEPLAY REQUIREMENTS:

- Side-view 2D fantasy battlefield.
- Six playable heroes fighting together as an automatic team.
- Automatic basic attacks and enemy targeting.
- Manually activated ultimate abilities.
- Strategic hero positioning and team formation.
- Multiple waves of enemies.
- Powerful boss enemies.
- Hero collection and summoning system.
- Seven unique hero classes.
- Five original fantasy races.
- Hero leveling, star upgrades and equipment.
- Weapons, armor and accessories.
- Tank and Guardian support systems.
- Anime-style fantasy character designs.
- Beautiful animated combat effects.

Create an original fantasy world, original characters, original graphics and original story.

FIRST PROTOTYPE:

1. Create a beautiful main menu.
2. Create a hero collection screen.
3. Create a team formation screen with six hero slots.
4. Create one playable side-view battle.
5. Add six sample heroes with different classes.
6. Add automatic attacks and special abilities.
7. Add enemy waves and one boss.
8. Add victory and defeat screens.
9. Add a functional reward and leveling system.
10. Save game progress locally.

The game must be playable, not just a static design or mockup.

Use mobile-friendly touch controls and a responsive Android layout.

Build the first playable prototype before adding online multiplayer.
"
